rootCauses.summary: Combat flow prepends multiple action/hurt/status entries, but every entry is absolutely positioned at top:0, so rapid events overlap in the same visual slot.
rootCauses.prediction: Assigning the newest three entries stable vertical lanes preserves chronological flow without adding enemy chrome or changing combat authority.
rootCauses.falsifier: Rapid events still share one top coordinate, more than three remain visible, or combat state/authority is changed.

observation.summary: Iteration 2 reuses and re-observes the immutable After from iteration 1 (d6cdb2 / version 4f6925cb). The combat feed can emit action, hurt and status events within the same 2.7s window. At this revision each .combat-feed-entry is absolute top:0, so concurrent entries occupy one coordinate before animation drift.

conditions.scenario: same immutable hunt staging; combat feed inspection

evidence.statement: Every event is prepended and remains for 2700ms.
All feed entries are position:absolute with top:0.

hypothesis.cause: Chronological events are stored as multiple DOM nodes but laid out in one absolute slot.
hypothesis.prediction: Bounded three-lane stacking makes rapid combat feedback readable while preserving sequence order and lightweight HUD.
hypothesis.falsifier: Entries still overlap or stacking requires changing Tidebreak/combat semantics.

candidates.reason: Reduces collisions by discarding readable time and still allows overlap.
Keeps the existing feed contract while making simultaneous recent events spatially distinct.

implementation.summary: Add pure bounded lane selection, assign newest three feed entries lanes, cap stale nodes, and offset lanes in CSS.

limitations: Portable balance probe does not cover combat DOM layout.
